museum.blurb: Acorn’s ARM desktop, still shipping from RISC OS Open — the icon bar and pinboard that defined British computing.
museum.notes: Showcase poster: RISC OS is ARM (the retired tile ran RPCEmu, not QEMU), so it has had no streamhost tile since the neko plane was deleted — poster + placard only for now. ROOL 5.30 softload ROM + HardDisc4. Archetype: beige-tower-crt; a bespoke Acorn RiscPC (the stackable slab that ran RISC OS) would be the ideal era-accurate model.
